_comment: Local test world only: the rehearsal's six markets on the test world's pools, through the operator flow, until the real pool list replaces them. Structure and page text only (the text is local test content); every number is in contracts/script/local/test-values.json.

disclosures.borrow: Borrowing against a liquidity position can lead to its liquidation when the position's value falls. Local test content for the development chains; not a risk review.
disclosures.lend: Lent assets are borrowed by others; withdrawals depend on the Hub's unborrowed balance. Local test content for the development chains; not a risk review.
